Hey guys !

I am thinking to buy a dedicated hard drive for recording - the main reason would be for the extra disk space. But after, I've read that a lot of people suggest is better to have a hard drive that is only for recording videos.

I still didn't understand which would be better: a 3.0 USB HDD or a Desktop HDD - 7200 RPM ? Do you have a separate HDD for recording and what do you guys suggest to buy ?

Thanks a lot in advance !

If you anticipate needing to move your video projects around to different machines, an external USB disk is probably the way to go. If you need fast performance you might consider getting two or more internal 7200RPM drives and setting them up in a RAID 0 configuration. (I use an online backup service that has unlimited storage so I set up my own RAID for performance over redundancy.)
Thanks a lot. Do you think it's better to get 1xHDD of 2TB or 2xHDD of 1TB ?

I guess it depends where your priorities are. Two disks in a RAID 0 will read/write faster than a single disk will. But adding more complexity to a system usually means more points for failure. If one if your two disks were to fail, you would lose the filesystem on both of them since it is one filesystem striped across two disks. Like I said above, since I use an online backup service with unlimited storage, I find the risk acceptable for the performance boost I get. There may also be price considerations as well.
